chronicles.title: Shadows of Humanity
chronicles.description: A Vampire: The Masquerade V5 chronicle set in small-town Radcliff, Kentucky in the autumn of 2000.
chronicles.core_pitch: A small coterie of young Kindred in rural Kentucky struggle to survive between a rigid Camarilla court in Louisville, military intelligence out of Fort Knox, and rogue Sabbat marauders lurking along the highway.
chronicles.chronicle_tenets:
1. Thou Shalt Not Kill the Innocent.
2. The Masquerade is Inviolable.
3. Respect the Haven of Another.
chronicles.main_factions:
• The Elysium Court (Camarilla): Ruling elite from Louisville.
• Fort Knox Military Intelligence: Mortals monitoring anomalous night activity.
• The Highway 31W Drifters: Anarch transients and rogue vampires.

lore_entries.title: The Blue Flames of 1974
lore_entries.revelation_vector: Library Microfiche / Interview with Elderly Resident
lore_entries.content: Official town records state the Old Grain Mill burned down due to faulty industrial wiring on Halloween night 1974. However, unreleased firefighter logs describe flames that burned with an unnatural blue-black hue and heat that warped steel girders in under five minutes. Several witnesses reported seeing three silhouetted figures sprinting away on foot toward Fort Knox at speeds exceeding sixty miles per hour.

lore_entries.title: The Abandonment of St. Christopher Parish
lore_entries.revelation_vector: Confession from Father Callahan / Church Basement Archives
lore_entries.content: In the winter of 1984, the Catholic diocese abruptly bolted the doors of St. Christopher Parish and reassigned the resident clergy overnight without explanation. While mortal rumors whispered of financial scandal, local Kindred know that an elder Lasombra conducted midnight confessionals in total darkness, granting mortals twisted absolution in exchange for their blood.

lore_entries.title: Project Nightwatch (1962)
lore_entries.revelation_vector: Classified Fort Knox File / Stolen Microfilm
lore_entries.content: During the height of the Cuban Missile Crisis, Army intelligence established an underground sub-basement below the gold bullion vaults designated "Project Nightwatch." Its mission was not anti-Soviet defense, but cataloging nocturnal human exsanguinations across the Ohio Valley and developing silver-nitrate ordnance to neutralize predatory humanoids.

rules_codex.title: Hunger & Rouse Checks
rules_codex.summary: How the hunger tracker functions from 0 to 5.
rules_codex.content: Vampires do not track blood points in V5; they track Hunger from 0 (sated) to 5 (ravenous). Anytime a vampire awakens at dusk, activates a discipline power, or mends damage, they make a Rouse Check (roll 1d10). On a 1-5, Hunger increases by 1. Hunger can only be reduced to 0 by completely draining a human to death.

rules_codex.title: Blood Surge
rules_codex.summary: Pushing undead physical capability beyond mortal limits.
rules_codex.content: A vampire can push their undead body beyond mortal limits, adding bonus dice to any single physical or mental dice pool equal to their Blood Potency bonus. This immediately triggers a Rouse Check.

rules_codex.title: Messy Criticals & Bestial Failures
rules_codex.summary: When the Beast overwhelms the vampire during a roll.
rules_codex.content:
Messy Critical: When a roll succeeds with a critical win (two 10s) and at least one 10 is on a red Hunger die, the Beast asserts its primal urges. The character succeeds, but in a brutal, horrifying, or Masquerade-breaching fashion.

Bestial Failure: When a roll fails and at least one 1 is rolled on a red Hunger die, the Beast causes a catastrophic failure or compels the vampire into a Compulsion.

rules_codex.title: Superficial vs. Aggravated Damage
rules_codex.summary: How damage works for Kindred vs Mortals.
rules_codex.content:
Superficial damage represents bruises, sprains, and shallow cuts. Kindred halve all Superficial damage from mundane sources (punches, clubs, bullets) before applying it to their Health track.

Aggravated damage represents life-threatening trauma. Fire, sunlight, and supernatural attacks (claws/fangs) deal Aggravated damage to Kindred.
